name: wp-brave-search-engine
description: [ENGINE EXTENSION] The engine classifies search.brave.com (and startpage.com) as organic search. The plugin has no rule for either and treats them as plain referrals.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #6): engine addition kept -- original note: engine -> medium=organic/channel organic_search; plugin -> source=search.brave.com, medium=referral. Brave/Startpage are intentional classifier additions; canonical source name 'brave' per ruling #4.
